title: Nee Thodu Unte Chalu – Prasad Nelapudi Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నీ నీడ ఉంటే చాలు ఎకొదువ మాకు లేదు
చాలునయా నీ కృప ప్రతి దినము పోషించుచున్నదయా
చాలునయా నీ కృప ప్రతి క్షణము ఆదరించుచున్నదయా
english: Nee thodu unte chaalu maakentho melu
nee needa unte chaalu ey kodhuva maaku ledhu
Chaalunayaa nee krupa prathi dinamu poshinchuchunnadayaa
chaalunayaa nee krupa prathi kshanamu aadharinchuchunnadayaa
intro: Nee Thodu Unte Chalu is the latest Telugu Christian song written & produced by Pastor Prasad Nelapudi, tuned by Tinnu Thereesh, sung by Tinnu Thereesh & Philip Gariki and music composed by renowned Telugu Christian music director, J K Christopher. This song video was released on October 30, 2022 through TPF Singapore YouTube channel.
